title: Storybook-aware Angular development server
description: Mirrors the @angular/build:dev-server options and adds the embedded Storybook mount.

buildTarget.description: Application build target whose output the development server serves.

port.description: Port the development server listens on.

host.description: Host the development server listens on.

proxyConfig.description: Proxy configuration file, resolved against the workspace root.

sslKey.description: SSL key to serve with HTTPS.

sslCert.description: SSL certificate to serve with HTTPS.

allowedHosts.description: Hosts the development server responds to. `true` allows any host.

define.description: Global identifiers replaced during the build.

headers.description: Custom headers added to every response.

open.description: Open the default browser once the server is listening.

liveReload.description: Reload the browser when the application rebuilds.

servePath.description: Path the application is served from.

hmr.description: Apply Angular component updates without a full page reload.

watch.description: Rebuild the application when its source files change.

poll.description: File watching polling interval in milliseconds.

inspect.description: Activate the Node.js inspector for server-side rendering.

storybookConfigDir.description: Overrides the Storybook configuration directory exported by storybook-middleware.js.

storybookBase.description: Overrides the embedded Storybook mount path exported by storybook-middleware.js.
